privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: OSINT Suite is a free, open-source reconnaissance tool. It is designed to collect as little data as possible: no accounts, no tracking, no personal data.
privacy.data: We do not store the domains or IP addresses you scan. Scan results are cached in memory (Redis) for up to 24 hours to speed up repeated queries, then discarded. No scan history is kept and no target is written to logs.
privacy.ip: Your IP address is used only in memory to enforce rate limits (5 scans per minute, 50 per day). It is never logged, stored, or shared.
privacy.cookies: The only cookie we set is NEXT_LOCALE, which remembers your language preference (English or Portuguese). There are no advertising, analytics, or third-party tracking cookies.
privacy.thirdParty: Scans query public data sources (DNS resolvers, WHOIS registries, certificate transparency logs, and similar public APIs). These queries contain only the target you submitted, never your identity. We do not use third-party analytics.
privacy.contact: Questions about privacy? Open an issue on the GitHub repository.

about.title: How OSINT Suite Works
about.intro: OSINT Suite is a free reconnaissance tool that gathers publicly available information about a domain name or IPv4 address. You enter a target, the server runs up to 20 independent modules in parallel, and the results are shown in a terminal-style dashboard. No account, no login, no database.
about.flow1: 1. You submit a domain or IPv4 address. The target is validated and checked against a blocklist (private ranges, localhost, internal TLDs) to prevent SSRF.
about.flow2: 2. A job is created and a job ID is returned immediately. The browser polls for progress while the scan runs in the background.
about.flow3: 3. Each module queries a public data source (DNS, WHOIS, certificate logs, public APIs) or performs a safe, read-only check. Every outbound request is validated before it is sent.
about.flow4: 4. Results are cached for 24 hours so repeated queries are instant. After that they are discarded. Nothing is written to a database.
about.modulesIntro: The 20 modules fall into five groups:
about.groupDns: DNS records, WHOIS registration data, DNSSEC validation, zone transfer (AXFR) attempts, and subdomain enumeration.
about.groupWeb: SSL/TLS certificate details, HTTP response headers, technology fingerprinting, CDN detection, and robots.txt / security.txt discovery.
about.groupNet: Port scanning of common services, IP geolocation, ASN lookup, reverse IP, and traceroute.
about.groupMail: SPF, DMARC and DKIM configuration checks, plus email address harvesting from public pages.
about.groupHist: Certificate transparency logs and Wayback Machine snapshots to reveal past infrastructure and content.
about.privacy: We do not store the targets you scan, we do not log your IP address, and we do not use analytics or tracking. Your IP is used only in memory to enforce rate limits. See the Privacy Policy for details.
about.limits: Scans are limited to 5 per minute and 50 per day per IP address. Results come from public sources and may be incomplete or outdated. Use the tool only on domains and IPs you own or are authorized to test.
about.cta: Enter a domain or IP address on the home page to start.
